acquisition_text:
I've been helped by so many people until now.
Now it's my turn to help others!
description:
A gentle noblewoman.
As Marie's childhood friend, they share an unparalleled bond. Their relationship remains unchanged in this world - they go gathering materials together, and she even helps clean Marie's room.
While she has a kind and mature personality, she occasionally lets slip a sharp tongue.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Caretaker characters' P.ATK and M.ATK by 40%.
leader_skill.name: Time for Cleaning

name: Schea
profile_voice_text: I'm Schea. I may not have any special abilities, but if there's anything I can help with, just let me know.

acquisition_text:
New discoveries, new encounters—
What an incredibly fascinating world!
description:
A young, ambitious alchemist.
She devotes herself day and night to research in pursuit of mastering alchemy. Intrigued by this world's alchemy as well, she often buries herself in books at the atelier.
Though she's a cool-headed theorist, she has a prideful side and hates to lose. Her eyes light up like a child's when faced with new discoveries.

leader_skill.description: Characters with Ice as their favored element receive 25% less damage.
leader_skill.name: I'll Protect You with This Shield!

name: Plachta
profile_voice_text: There are so many things in this world I've never seen before. How absolutely fascinating!

acquisition_text:
Now then, are you ready?
Let me invite you on a mysterious journey!
description:
An alchemist who loves to travel.
Her ribbon was prepared by her sister Liane so she could match with Ilmeria, who is both her rival and friend.
Apparently, wearing this ribbon makes her feel confident that she's a genius alchemist.

leader_skill.description: Characters with Air as their favored element deal 50% more skill damage when their attack target is stunned.
leader_skill.name: Let the Ribbon Dance in the Wind

name: Firis
profile_voice_text:
This ribbon is super cute and I love it!
It goes all fluffy when I move, fluffy fluffy♪

acquisition_text:
Time for this genius to make her entrance!
I'll show you just what my talent can do!
description: A young alchemist who proclaims herself a genius. She travels across the Lantarna continent helping people with her alchemy to make her abilities known. She shares a competitive yet close friendship with Firis, considering her both a rival and her best friend. Though she can be prideful and childish at times, she's a hard worker who approaches alchemy with genuine dedication.

leader_skill.description: Characters whose favored element is Air gain P. DEF and M. DEF +10% and deal 50% more skill damage to stunned targets.
leader_skill.name: How About Some First-Class Help?

name: Ilmeria
profile_voice_text:
I'm Ilmeria!
A genius alchemist acknowledged by everyone!

acquisition_text:
Looks like there's still a whole world out there I don't know about!
Let's go discover new sights together!
description: An adventure-loving alchemist. She used to work at the cafe, Star's Cocoon, in the capital of the Lantarna Kingdom, but has set off in search of new grand adventures. Her heart leaps at the thought of traveling with her beloved companions, including her close friend Klaudia and her junior alchemist Resna.

leader_skill.description: Characters whose favored element is Stab gain P. ATK +40%
leader_skill.name: Adventure Comes When You Least Expect It!

name: Ryza
profile_voice_text:
If you've got any problems,
leave them to Reisalin Stout!

acquisition_text:
It's amazing that there are worlds we've never seen before!
Would you like to go together?
description: A merchant's daughter and capable businesswoman. She provides support to traveling merchants across various regions. Though she finds fulfillment in her busy daily life, she feels lonely about rarely getting to spend time with her close friend Ryza. She strongly desires to embark on another grand adventure with Ryza and watches for any opportunity to do so.

leader_skill.description: All allies gain P. ATK and M. ATK +10% for each Kurken Island character in the party
leader_skill.name: Memories of That Summer Close to Heart

name: Klaudia
profile_voice_text:
I'm so excited about our journey to new lands!
Let's have a fun adventure together.

acquisition_text:
Then, as a sign of our friendship--
Perhaps I should also dress up a bit?
description: A wandering alchemist who taught Ryza alchemy. Though he has deep ties with Lara of the Polar Night Alchemists, they have now formed a cooperative relationship. As proof of their friendship, she gifted him this outfit. Being an extreme sweet tooth, he can't forget the taste of the pastries Lara once treated him to, and hopes to taste them again.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' P. ATK and M. ATK by 10% for each Mentor character in the party.
leader_skill.name: Inherited Knowledge

name: Empel
profile_voice_text: I'm Empel. This outfit was given to me as a sign of friendship. I must say, it's quite pleasing.

acquisition_text:
Now then, it's time for the party.
...Perhaps being led by the hand isn't so bad once in a while.
description: An elite member of the Royal Knights known as the Knight of Midnight Sun. For a royal party, she has set aside her usual white armor and donned a crimson dress. The outfit is designed to allow for easy movement in case of unexpected situations. All who have seen her in this elegant dress have discovered a new charm to the Knight of Midnight Sun, Juna.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Knight characters' P. DEF and M. DEF by 35%.
leader_skill.name: Elegant Knight of the Starry Night

name: Juna
profile_voice_text:
I am Juna Waitz. Though it may seem unsuitable for a knight,
I shall graciously wear this dress.

acquisition_text:
Being able to celebrate the new year with everyone...
Hehe... It makes me so happy.
description: Resna's alchemy mentor. Since her disciple became independent, she has been traveling the world for her own purposes. She values the connections between people, and has a rather formal side to her, making it a rule to visit and give gifts to those who have helped her at the start of each year. Few know where she was born or how she has lived her life.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Ice affinity characters' M. ATK by 40%.
leader_skill.name: I'll Freeze You to the Core

name: Saskia
profile_voice_text:
I'm Saskia. I'm so happy we can celebrate the new year together.
Let's get along this year too~

acquisition_text:
When you lose your way, follow my lead.
I shall guide you to our ideal country.
description:
An alchemist and ruler of the Lara Kingdom.
She travels to various regions in search of talented individuals to recruit as vassals of the Lara Kingdom. Though she can be somewhat forceful, she is adored by her subjects and vassals for her caring nature.
When she wears this outfit coordinated with Empel, she particularly enjoys how it makes him look like her secretary.

leader_skill.description: All allies gain P. ATK and M. ATK +10% and Skill Damage and Stun Damage +20% for each Noble character in the party.
leader_skill.name: Grace in All Things

name: Lara
profile_voice_text: I am Lara Trockel. As one who would be queen, let us proceed with elegance and splendor.

acquisition_text:
I shall dedicate my all to you—
Hehe, let's make this thoroughly enjoyable.
description:
Leader of the Polar Night Alchemists.
She has repeatedly monopolized and seized materials across various regions to further her alchemical research in pursuit of her desires.
While ruthless toward her enemies, she provides generous support to those who cooperate with her. She is skilled at cooking and surprisingly caring beneath her exterior.

leader_skill.description: Bolt affinity characters deal 100% more Skill Damage to stunned targets.
leader_skill.name: For the Sake of Our Desires

name: Criselda
profile_voice_text:
I am Criselda. Though there have been some complications...
Hehe, I'd be happy if we could get along.

acquisition_text:
My feelings for my homeland and my sister—
I carry both close to my heart as I grow stronger.
description:
A young girl who serves as a Sacred Knight in the Nova.
Though not related by blood, she looks up to Alvina as an older sister.
While she maintains a cool and mysterious air, she has a natural side to her and sometimes surprises others with her unexpected actions.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Infinite Island Chain characters' P. ATK and M. ATK by 50%.
leader_skill.name: Young Warrior Who Swears Vengeance

name: Bepp
profile_voice_text: I am Bepp Zimlock, Sacred Knight of the Nova and the protector of Alvina.

acquisition_text:
Let me guide you on your unknown adventure!
...Just kidding!
description:
The Star Guide of Nova and a secret alchemist.
After meeting an alchemist who arrived on the island, she became deeply involved in alchemy herself. Since pursuing work outside one's divine calling is forbidden in the sacred lands of Nova, she keeps her activities as an alchemist hidden from others.
Quick-witted and sharp-tongued, she often finds herself getting into clever mischief.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Infinite Island Chain characters' P.ATK and stun damage by 30%
leader_skill.name: Star Guide

name: Alvina
profile_voice_text: I'm Alvina! Star Guide of Nova and... a fledgling alchemist!

acquisition_text: The path toward endless possibilities — I'll pave the way with my own hands!
description:
An alchemist seeking World's End.
She has become well-known in the Kingdom of Lantarna for using alchemy to resolve various requests and incidents. In pursuit of her dream to find World's End and revive alchemy, she ventures beyond Lantarna to explore the islands across the sea.
Her knowledge of and love for alchemy remains unchanged—if anything, it has only grown stronger.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all Slash affinity allies' stun damage and critical damage by 50%.
leader_skill.name: Clear the Path and Press On!

name: Resna
profile_voice_text: A new journey begins! I'll show you how different I've become from who I was before!

acquisition_text: I will protect you with these hands—for that is the divine duty bestowed upon me.
description:
A Sacred Knight of Nova and mother of one.
Earnest and devout in her faith, she's dedicated to her duties. She's one of the country's most skilled fighters and has even won martial arts tournaments. She's also an excellent cook with a domestic side and dotes on her daughter.
She's been looking after Alvina since long ago and remains concerned for her well-being.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Slash affinity characters' P.ATK, M.ATK, P.DEF, and M.DEF by 25%.
leader_skill.name: Nova's Strongest Sacred Knight

name: Janne
profile_voice_text: As a Sacred Knight of Nova, I'll show you how I protect everyone.

acquisition_text:
Whatever awaits at the end of this journey...
I'll move forward without hesitation.
description:
A warrior with amnesia and an alchemist.
Though troubled by the question of who she is and her purpose, she fights for the friends and family who support her. Believing that the answers she seeks lie across the sea, she sets out on a journey across the Lantarna continent with Resna.
Even with her lost memories, she remains laid-back and food-loving as ever.

leader_skill.description: Grants Laid-back characters Initiative and boosts P.ATK by 35%.
leader_skill.name: Let's Finish This Quick and Get Some Food!

name: Valeria
profile_voice_text: I'm Valeria. There's a lot I've forgotten, but I plan to recover it all, bit by bit.

acquisition_text:
My alchemy will surely be of help.
So, won't you come along with me?
description: The only alchemist in the Aladiss Research Team. In her original world, alchemy was considered a forbidden art, so she joined the investigation team to discover the truth behind it. She cherishes her mother's words: "Learn how to judge what is right by yourself."

leader_skill.description: All allies gain 10% M.ATK and M.DEF for each Aladiss Research Team member.
leader_skill.name: Following Memories

name: Yumia
profile_voice_text:
I'm Yumia, an alchemist.
I hope to make new discoveries in this world.

acquisition_text:
I am Viktor of the Eustera Knights.
Let us swear to fight in the name of justice.
description: A knight belonging to the Aladiss Research Team. He's been assigned to monitor Yumia, who practices the forbidden art of alchemy. Though born into nobility, his family fell from grace due to a disaster in their territory. While he has a strong sense of justice and loyalty, he can be rather inflexible at times.

leader_skill.description: All allies gain 20% skill damage and stun damage for each Aladiss Research Team member.
leader_skill.name: Unwavering Justice

name: Viktor
profile_voice_text:
When the time comes, I will be everyone's shield.
So please, follow me with confidence.

acquisition_text:
I-I'm Lenja...!
I'll do my very best to be helpful...!
description: A young girl of the demihuman race known as Welleks. As a racial trait, she possesses high physical capabilities and mana affinity, serving as a member of the investigation team. Despite her abilities, she's timid and lacks self-confidence, often apologizing for various things.

leader_skill.description: Aladiss Research Team members gain 40% battle item damage and 50% skill damage & burst skill damage.
leader_skill.name: Journey of Atonement

name: Lenja
profile_voice_text:
I-I'm Lenja...!
I'll do my best to be helpful, so...

acquisition_text:
Leave the fashion coordination to me!
Let's have a stylish adventure together!
description: A member of the Research Team and Viktor's younger sister. She has a strong passion for clothing and accessories, maintaining her fashionable spirit even during investigations. Her bright and proactive personality, combined with her sharp intuition, helps her complement areas where her brother falls short.

leader_skill.description: Characters with Fire affinity deal 100% more skill damage when attacking stunned targets.
leader_skill.name: Fashion-Forward Mind

name: Isla
profile_voice_text: Fashion is important at all times! After all, don't people who dress well just shine brighter?

acquisition_text:
I'll do things my own way.
...Don't worry, I keep my promises.
description: A seasoned adventurer who loves valuable items. Having lived without relying on others, he survived in the slums while taking on shady jobs. Due to certain circumstances, he now works with the Aladiss Research Team. Living by his own aesthetic shaped by his extraordinary life experiences, he refuses to be bound by others.

leader_skill.description: Boosts P.ATK, M.ATK, P.DEF, and M.DEF by 25% for characters with Strike affinity.
leader_skill.name: Personal Aesthetic

name: Rutger
profile_voice_text:
Name's Rutger. I'll take on requests if the pay's right.
Just don't expect me to take on anything that's not worth my time.

acquisition_text:
I'm looking for something.
Won't you take me along on your journey?
description:
A mysterious woman who is a member of the research team.
Formerly active as a mercenary, she possesses such high capability that she can conduct investigations even on her own.
While she maintains a mysterious aura, she also has a cheerful and mischievous side.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Aladiss Research Team characters' P.ATK, M.ATK, P.DEF, and M.DEF by 30%.
leader_skill.name: Enigmatic Ex-Mercenary

name: Nina
profile_voice_text:
I'm Nina. Usually I work as a mercenary.
Hehe... I live each day freely.

acquisition_text:
I've meticulously crafted my theories—
Now, let me prove their validity to you.
description: An exchange student from ACSE Business School. A logical thinker with extensive knowledge of business management from ancient to modern times, specializing in data-driven strategy development. Despite being a student, she has received numerous advisory offers from companies and has gained idol-like popularity in certain business circles as a young genius.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' P.ATK and M.ATK by 10% for each Resleriana Academy character in the party.
leader_skill.name: Learn Together

name: Plachta
profile_voice_text: I'm Plachta, an exchange student here. Let's learn and grow together.

acquisition_text:
Nice to meet you! Are you a student at this academy?
Would you like to be friends?
description: An exchange student from ACSE Business School. As the daughter of a famous company president, she studies business management to eventually succeed her father's work. With her friendly personality, she excels at creating promotional strategies that connect with people's emotions. She forms an excellent partnership with her classmate Plachta, each complementing the other's weaknesses.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' M.ATK and M.DEF by 10% for each Resleriana Academy character in the party.
leader_skill.name: Will You Be My Friend?

name: Klaudia
profile_voice_text: As a businesswoman's daughter, I always keep myself well-informed. Don't hesitate to come to me if you need anything!

acquisition_text:
So this is Lantarna Academy...
I can't wait to see what kind of encounters await me!
description:
An exchange student from Schaffen Science Academy.
She sees alchemy as a rival field to science. Skilled with her hands, she has a talent for tinkering with machinery.
She's been friends with Flocke, who attends the same academy, for a long time and often took care of her when she was ill.

leader_skill.description: Boosts M.ATK by 50% for characters with Air affinity.
leader_skill.name: The Winds of Change Blow Toward Science!

name: Heidi
profile_voice_text:
Hey there! I'm Heidi, an exchange student!
Leave any mechanical work to me! Looking forward to working with you!

acquisition_text:
I'm Flocke, an exchange student!
Please let me study many things at this academy!
description:
An exchange student from the Schaffen Science Academy.
She is enthusiastic about learning and possesses broad knowledge across various scientific fields. She is eager about this exchange opportunity, believing there must be things to learn from alchemy as well.
Though physically weak and often absent from school in her younger days, she now lives a healthy life thanks to the support of Heidi and others.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Resleriana Academy characters' M.ATK and M.DEF by 40%.
leader_skill.name: A Place to Be Together

name: Flocke
profile_voice_text:
I'm Flocke, an exchange student!
I think I can be of help when it comes to science!

acquisition_text:
Alchemy has infinite possibilities!
Won't you explore them with me?
description:
An energetic and spirited alchemist.
She studied alchemy at an academy in a certain town. Currently, she travels across the Lantarna continent in pursuit of alchemical truth.
While cheerful and kind, she can be lazy and hates doing troublesome things.
She has a tendency to try solving problems with explosives, which earned her the nickname "Bomberwoman."

leader_skill.description: Boosts Student characters' M.ATK and M.DEF by 25%.
leader_skill.name: Academy Graduate

name: Marie
profile_voice_text:
I'm Marlone. I studied at the Academy.
I hope my alchemy can be of help.

acquisition_text:
Let us pledge to study and grow further
so we may serve as role models for our fellow students.
description:
A second-year student in Lantarna Academy's alchemy department.
An exemplary student who excels in both academics and martial arts, she has visited various schools as an exchange student.
A member of the Alchemy Club, she's friends with Sophie and her classmates. She aims to become the next Student Council President.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Diligent characters' P.DEF and M.DEF by 50%.
leader_skill.name: Rare Leadership

name: Juna
profile_voice_text:
I'll never spare any effort
to make our academy an even better place.

acquisition_text:
Reviving alchemy is also my wish.
Now then, shall we go together?
description:
Resna's alchemy mentor.
During her travels, she stopped at Resna's village and began teaching her the basics of alchemy.
While she has a bright and straightforward personality, she can be quite strict when it comes to alchemy.
She's also quite messy in her personal life, often requiring Resna to take care of her.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' critical damage by 5% for each Lantarna character in the party.
leader_skill.name: The Comet Star is With Us

name: Saskia
profile_voice_text:
I'm Saskia. Like Resna, I'm an alchemist with dreams.
Let's aim for World's End together.

acquisition_text:
Reviving alchemy is my wish as well.
Now then, let's go together.
description:
Resna's alchemy mentor.
During her travels, she stopped at Resna's village and taught her the basics of alchemy.
Though she has a bright and straightforward personality, she shows a strict side when it comes to alchemy.
She's also quite carefree in her personal life, often causing Resna to worry about her.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' critical damage by 5% for each Lantarna character.
leader_skill.name: The Comet Star Is with Us

name: August
profile_voice_text:
I am Saskia. Like Resna, I'm an alchemist with dreams.
Set your sights on World's End.

acquisition_text:
I've fulfilled my vow to the shooting stars!
Watch closely as I take on the form of a true knight!
description:
A beast-girl who serves in the Royal Knights and is Resna's childhood friend.
Pursuing her lifelong dream of becoming a knight, she now travels as Resna's guardian, accompanying the alchemist on her journey.
Though she has grown into a proper knight, her energetic nature remains unchanged.
As the daughter of a blacksmith, she fights wielding hammers in both hands.

leader_skill.description: Air affinity characters gain Skill Damage and Critical Damage +50%
leader_skill.name: Feel the Wind of My Hammer!

name: Izana
profile_voice_text:
I am Izana of the Lantarna Royal Knights!
...Ehehe, pleased to meet you!

acquisition_text:
A genius doesn't choose their battlefield—
I'll follow you anywhere!
description:
A self-proclaimed genius and Resna's friend.
She previously served as an enforcer codenamed Crow for the Moonlight Society, an unofficial kingdom organization.
She joined forces with Resna to help her reach World's End.
She has strong confidence in her combat abilities, which is backed by her proven skills.
She has a proud personality and hates to lose.

leader_skill.description: Boosts burst skill damage by 75% for characters with Ice affinity.
leader_skill.name: Tremble Before Me!

name: Johanna
profile_voice_text: I'll show those outsiders beyond the continent what this genius can really do!

acquisition_text:
Don't worry.
I'll protect your back.
description:
An adventurer and Totori's friend.
At Totori's request, she accompanies her on her journey.
She has immense pride and takes great honor in her family name.
Though she carries herself like a proper lady, she becomes quite flustered whenever Totori is mentioned.

leader_skill.description: All allies gain 20% skill damage and stun damage for each Arland character.
leader_skill.name: Noble Daughter of Arland

name: Mimi
profile_voice_text:
I'm Mimi. In my world, I was quite well-known
as an adventurer, you know?

acquisition_text:
Even warriors need rest sometimes.
—Want to join me?
description:
A mysterious wandering warrior.
She has traveled alongside the alchemist Empel for a long time.
While blunt in personality, she has a caring side.
Her attire is connected to Keiun culture and is traditionally worn during festivals.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Air affinity characters' P.DEF and M.DEF by 35%.
leader_skill.name: Wrapped in Spirit Winds

name: Lila
profile_voice_text:
A warrior of the White Fang clan in festival attire...
Life can be interesting if you live it long enough.

acquisition_text:
If my experience can help everyone become stronger,
then I'll always be here to lend a hand!
description:
An alchemist from a fishing village.
She collaborated with Resna and her companions to venture beyond the Lantarna continent, fulfilling her long-held dream.
With her knowledge of seafaring, she serves as the captain's first mate.
She tends to speak her mind honestly, sometimes unintentionally discouraging others, but she's been making an effort to be more mindful lately.

leader_skill.description: Arland characters gain M.ATK and M.DEF +40%.
leader_skill.name: Arland's Renowned Adventurer

name: Totori
profile_voice_text:
I'm Totori. I'm an alchemist and an adventurer.
I'd be happy if I could help everyone out.

acquisition_text:
Today's a special day! Won't you join me
to make it a wonderful one?
description: A cheerful and energetic alchemist. She usually bakes pies at the cafe Star's Cocoon on the Lantarna continent. Though she can be a bit clumsy and airheaded at times, she's positive and hardworking. While vacationing and sightseeing in Karlston, she dresses up in a cute dress and becomes like a princess from a storybook.

leader_skill.description: Ice affinity characters gain P.DEF and M.DEF +35%.
leader_skill.name: Princess Rorona's Prayer

name: Rorona
profile_voice_text:
I'm not really used to wearing clothes like this,
so I'm feeling a bit nervous...!

acquisition_text:
I'm not particularly interested in the ocean...
But if you want to go, I'll come with you.
description:
A darkness-cloaked alchemist.
She previously belonged to the Polar Night Alchemists and assisted Criselda.
She wears a swimsuit prepared together with Resna to participate in Lara's "Lara Beach Grand Prix."
She possesses the strength to work devotedly for those important to her, including her friend Criselda.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Lantarna characters' P.ATK by 40%.
leader_skill.name: First Time at the Ocean with Everyone

name: Antje
profile_voice_text:
This is my first time playing at the ocean...
But this might be... fun, I suppose.

acquisition_text:
Come on, let's go swimming!
I'll take care of any enemies lurking in the water!
description:
A beautiful warrior with amnesia.
She didn't see the need for a swimsuit, but still captivated everyone with how great it looked on her.
Once she tried it on, she found it very light and easy to move in, which was perfect for her as she believes that striking first is the key to victory.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Lantarna characters' burst skill damage by 100%.
leader_skill.name: Unmatched in Mobility!

name: Valeria
profile_voice_text:
I'm a great swimmer! Leave any battles in the water to me!
I can adapt to almost any situation!

acquisition_text:
I'm not particularly interested in the ocean...
But if you want to go, I'll come with you.
description:
A darkness-cloaked alchemist.
She previously belonged to the Polar Night Alchemists and assisted Criselda.
She wears a swimsuit prepared together with Resna to participate in Lara's "Lara Beach Grand Prix."
She possesses the strength to work devotedly for those important to her, including her friend Criselda.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Lantarna characters' P.ATK by 40%.
leader_skill.name: First Time at the Ocean with Everyone

name: Antje
profile_voice_text:
This is my first time playing at the ocean...
But this might be... fun, I suppose.

acquisition_text: I'll shine even brighter than the blazing sun!
description:
A fledgling alchemist passionate about reviving alchemy.
She dreams of bringing alchemy back to its former glory and works tirelessly toward that goal every day.
To enjoy the summer, she's wearing a precious swimsuit chosen by her best friend Izana.
Even in this fairy-like adorable outfit, she doesn't forget her straw hat for sun protection.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Seasonal characters' burst skill damage and stun damage by 75%.
leader_skill.name: Summer Calls for Bold Choices

name: Resna
profile_voice_text: I'm not great with strong sunlight, but... I'll power through with this swimsuit!

acquisition_text:
To the endless blue sea beyond—
Let the Kingdom of Lara's name be known!
description: An alchemist and queen of the Kingdom of Lara. She was formerly a member of the Polar Night Alchemists and worked for the sake of her own nation. Wearing a stunning swimsuit, she graces the Lara Beach Grand Prix that she herself sponsors. She strives to conduct herself with dignity befitting a queen, caring for others and earning the admiration of her vassals and citizens.

leader_skill.description: Reduces damage received by 25% for characters with Slash affinity.
leader_skill.name: Your Queen Supports You

name: Lara
profile_voice_text:
Ensuring the safety of the seas is also a queen's duty.
Now, let's head out on patrol!

acquisition_text:
To the endless blue sea beyond—
Let the Kingdom of Lara's name be known!
description: An alchemist and queen of the Kingdom of Lara. She was formerly a member of the Polar Night Alchemists and worked for the sake of her own nation. Wearing a stunning swimsuit, she graces the Lara Beach Grand Prix that she herself sponsors. She strives to conduct herself with dignity befitting a queen, caring for others and earning the admiration of her vassals and citizens.

leader_skill.description: Reduces damage received by 25% for characters with Slash affinity.
leader_skill.name: Your Queen Supports You

name: Lara
profile_voice_text:
Ensuring the safety of the seas is also a queen's duty.
Now, let's head out on patrol!

acquisition_text: Let's go see the unknown world beyond the sea together!
description: A free-spirited alchemist girl. Her curiosity overflowing, she wraps herself in a gorgeous swimsuit and dives into a new summer. The scarf that calls to mind her usual hat is one of her particular touches. The sandy beach that sparkles with reflected sunlight makes her presence shine even brighter.

leader_skill.description: Boosts skill damage by 75% when attack target is stunned for Kurken Island characters.
leader_skill.name: Grand Adventure by the Shore

name: Ryza
profile_voice_text:
I'm all set for swimming!
I'm gonna gather tons of materials sleeping on the ocean floor!

acquisition_text:
Even the deep ocean floor isn't scary when everyone's together.
Come on, let's go!
description:
A merchant's daughter.
She accompanies a caravan introduced by her best friend Ryza, honing her work skills day by day.
This time, she's stretching herself a bit by trying on a more mature swimsuit.
She's excited about this new summer she gets to spend with Ryza and the others.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Seasonal characters' M.ATK by 50%.
leader_skill.name: Beach Charm

name: Klaudia
profile_voice_text: This outfit might be a little too adventurous... But if I'm with Ryza, I'll be fine!

acquisition_text:
There's something I seek in this ocean.
Will you help me search for it?
description:
A talented alchemist.
She was formerly the leader of the Polar Night Alchemists, acting according to her own ambitions.
She was imprisoned for a time, but is currently on parole and has volunteered to help with the Lara Beach Grand Prix.
She maintains a calm demeanor and treats everyone kindly, though she sometimes likes to tease people she's taken a liking to.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' P.ATK and M.ATK by 10% for each Lantarna character in the party.
leader_skill.name: Forget Your Station and Have Fun

name: Criselda
profile_voice_text: Everyone looks wonderful in their swimsuits. I'll make sure to burn this sight into my memory, thoroughly.

acquisition_text:
On a hot day like this, let's play in the water!
This genius will play with you!
description:
A self-proclaimed genius girl.
She previously worked as a monitor for the Moonlight Society under the codename "Thrush."
To win the "Lara Beach Grand Prix" and claim glory, she dons a swimsuit prepared together with Izana.
With her high pride and competitive nature that hates losing, she gives her all in any contest.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Slash affinity characters' skill damage and stun damage by 40%.
leader_skill.name: I'll Slice Right Through This Heat!

name: Johanna
profile_voice_text:
Hmph. As expected of the genius Johanna!
Any outfit looks good on me!

acquisition_text:
Leave it to me! I'll use my ninja techniques to
scatter these evildoers and show you what I can do!
description:
A ninja from southern Keiun.
She serves the Doumen family as a ninja and has been childhood friends with her master Kanariya since they were young.
Raised from childhood with traditional ninja education, she has been influenced by Kanariya to develop an appreciation for new things, often attempting new ninja techniques that perplex those around her.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Keiun characters' M.ATK by 50% and burst skill damage by 50%.
leader_skill.name: Ninja of a New Era

name: Kimon
profile_voice_text: My name is Kimon. I am a ninja serving the Doumen family. Please treat me well.

acquisition_text:
A diviner is one who exorcises evil...
I'll exorcise your melancholy feelings as well.
description:
A well-known diviner within Keiun.
He is childhood friends with Kaburaya, the head of the Doumen family that governs southern Keiun, and Kimon, a ninja who serves her.
He takes great care of his appearance, sparing no effort in skincare and clothing selection. Though his flashy and arrogant behavior stands out, he claims to be a man who gets things done when it matters.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' battle item damage by 10% and P.DEF & M.DEF by 10% for each Keiun character in the party.
leader_skill.name: Beautiful Diviner of the Far East

name: Towa
profile_voice_text: Childhood friend of Lady Kaburaya, head of the Doumen family, and beautiful diviner, Towa Shigan. Pleased to make your acquaintance.

acquisition_text:
If there's the light of Venus in the heavens, then there's the brilliance of Kaburaya on earth!
Come now, follow me!
description:
The young lady of the Doumen family, who governs southern Keiun.
She has been childhood friends with the ninja Kimon and the diviner Towa since they were young.
She has been skilled with the sword since childhood and has won the Keiun martial arts tournament with her unique swordsmanship.
She prefers new and beneficial things over useless old traditions.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' P.ATK and M.ATK by 10% and skill damage and stun damage by 20% for each Keiun character in the party.
leader_skill.name: Lord Who Mastered the Martial Way

name: Kaburaya
profile_voice_text:
I am Kaburaya Doumen, lord of Keiun!
Let my strength serve you well.

acquisition_text:
I offer a prayer for the safety of this journey...
Please allow me to give you my blessing...
description:
A shrine maiden serving the Doumen family.
Originally serving at a shrine, she was immediately won over by Kaburaya's direct persuasion and became attached to the Doumen family.
Though she appears quiet and fragile due to her earnest nature, she possesses an inner strength.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Keiun characters' M.ATK and M.DEF by 40%.
leader_skill.name: Reverent Shrine Maiden

name: Chitose
profile_voice_text:
I am Chitose Hateruma... As a shrine maiden,
I would be honored to be of service to you all...

acquisition_text: Half-hearted help is completely meaningless. If you're going to do something, then fight with everything you've got!
description: A homunculus created by the Palme and the third member of the Miraculous Nine. She travels around various lands as an adventurer while carrying out management duties under orders from the Palme. She values chic styles and takes pride in having a complete, coordinated outfit. However, she doesn't mind getting completely disheveled when the situation calls for it, as long as it means staying true to her own way of life that she discovered during her travels.

leader_skill.description: Boosts P.ATK by 40% for characters with Strike affinity.
leader_skill.name: Carefree Wanderer

name: Jelka
profile_voice_text: I'm Jelka. We help each other out when we're in trouble. That's what style is all about, don't you think?

description: A homunculus created by the Palme and the third member of the Miraculous Nine. She travels around various lands as an adventurer while carrying out management duties under orders from the Palme. Due to her cheerful and caring personality, she plays a role that binds the Nine together. She values chic styles and has a compassionate side.

leader_skill.description: Boosts skill damage and burst skill damage by 50% for Nurturer characters.
leader_skill.name: Repay Kindness with Kindness

name: Jelka
profile_voice_text: I'm Jelka, the third of the Miraculous Nine. Humans always make fascinating discoveries, you know.

acquisition_text:
I'll repay the kindness I've received!
I'll take care of you humans too, all of you!
description:
A homunculus created by the Palme and the fifth member of the Miraculous Nine.
Along with the other members of the Nine, she carries out management duties under orders from the Palme.
She is loyal to orders and has a passionate, earnest personality. However, her excessive fervor can sometimes cause the other members of the Nine to keep their distance from her.

leader_skill.description: Boosts P. DEF and M. DEF by 35% for characters with Strike affinity.
leader_skill.name: Hot-Blooded Hero of Chivalry

name: Gou
profile_voice_text:
I'm Gou, the fifth of the Miraculous Nine.
I take pride in this name.

acquisition_text:
Ah! Found you! I was getting bored.
Would you like to play with Marie?
description: A wicked little servant working for the leader of the conglomerate DOATEC. She accompanied her master on vacation to the Venus Islands, but after being treated like a child, she's determined to win the Venus Festival and prove she's a grown-up. Though she has a somewhat aloof personality, her emotions show on her face when she's happy, revealing her age-appropriate side.

leader_skill.description: Seasonal characters gain Initiative and Skill Damage +50%.
leader_skill.name: Wicked Lil' Servant

name: Marie Rose
profile_voice_text:
My name is Marie Rose.
Call me Marie!

acquisition_text: Just like all the people of Venus, I will strive to become a beautiful and strong alchemist!
description:
An alchemist aiming to reach World's End.
Due to a series of unexpected circumstances, she ended up stranded in the Venus Isles and entered the Venus Fest—a festival where participants compete in strength and beauty.
She deeply loves alchemy and possesses vast knowledge on the subject. With her earnest personality, she is determined to give her all now that she has committed to participating in the Venus Festival.

leader_skill.description: For each Seasonal character in the party, boosts all allies' skill damage and stun damage by 20%.
leader_skill.name: New Horizons on the Eternal Summer Isles

name: Resna
profile_voice_text: I'm a bit intimidated by the Venus Festival, but... if I've been given this opportunity, I want to give it my all.

acquisition_text:
Wow, this looks like so much fun!
I'll show you all sorts of things!
description: A gentle and laid-back schoolgirl raised by her kind grandmother, with a top-secret side. She won a vacation ticket to the Venus Islands in a lucky draw at a shopping district and decided to visit. She happily accepted the invitation to the Venus Fest, treating it like a neighborhood festival. Despite her calm demeanor, she enjoys watching wrestling and studying martial arts techniques, and sometimes even imitates them.

leader_skill.description: Boosts skill damage by 100% for Strike affinity characters when attacking a stunned target.
leader_skill.name: Top-Secret Schoolgirl

name: Honoka
profile_voice_text:
Hello there! I'm Honoka.
Let's have a fun vacation together!

acquisition_text: Someday I'll become a strong, beautiful, and cool swimsuit hero too...or something like that!
description: A Star Guide of the sacred lands of Nova, and an alchemist. Through a series of events, she ended up wandering into the Venus Isles and participating in the Venus Fest, a festival where goddesses compete in strength and beauty. Quick-witted and meticulous by nature, she's well aware of her own charm and actively appeals with her cuteness during the Venus Fest.

leader_skill.description: Boosts burst skill damage for Seasonal characters by 100%.
leader_skill.name: Talent Blooming on a Tropical Isle

name: Alvina
profile_voice_text: Come to think of it, I may have never worn a swimsuit before. Well? Take a look! Does it suit me?

acquisition_text: Those who disrupt the order of the Society will be eliminated by me.
description:
A girl who hides her face behind a mask.
She serves as an enforcer for the Moonlight Society, an unrecognized organization in the kingdom, and lives according to the words of her grandfather Oliver, the Society's leader.
People call her Crow and fear her mysterious nature, as she appears from the shadows and vanishes back into them without a trace.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' skill damage and critical damage by 20% for each Dark Memories character in the party.
leader_skill.name: Guardian of the Shadow Order

name: Crow
profile_voice_text: I am Crow, enforcer of the Moonlight Society. You won't escape me.

acquisition_text:
This outcome was part of my plan from the beginning—
Please make use of my strategic insight.
description: A homunculus created by the Palme, the sixth of the Miraculous Nine. Together with the other members, she carries out management duties under the Palme's orders. She excels at devising strategies and prefers things to proceed according to plan. She has a fondness for cleanliness and is often polishing her favorite glasses.

leader_skill.description: Characters with Stab affinity gain P.ATK +50%.
leader_skill.name: Talented Strategist

name: Liebe
profile_voice_text:
I am Liebe. Leave strategic planning to me.
I shall devise the perfect plan.

acquisition_text: Father, Mother, my dear siblings... Why do they not understand our mission...?
description:
A homunculus created by the Palme, and the fifth of the Miraculous Nine.
Along with the other Miraculous Nine, he carries out "management" under the Palme's orders.
He has a passionate and earnest personality. He cares deeply for his siblings, and respects Saskia and August as Mother and Father.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' P.ATK and M.ATK by 10% and skill damage and stun damage by 20% for each Dark Memories character in the party.
leader_skill.name: Mission Bestowed by Father and Mother

name: Gou
profile_voice_text: I'm Gou, fifth of the Miraculous Nine. My sisters often say I'm too overbearing, but...?

acquisition_text:
I'll do my very best, so
make sure to give me lots of praise, okay?
description:
A homunculus created by the Palme, and the fourth of the Miraculous Nine.
Along with the other Miraculous Nine, he carries out management under the Palme's direction.
He act capricious, but is skilled at handling things efficiently and reading situations well.
An avid collector of beautiful items, especially gemstones.

leader_skill.description: Miraculous Nine characters gain Initiative and Critical Damage +50%.
leader_skill.name: Bewitching Gaze

name: Citrine
profile_voice_text:
I'm Citrine. Since we're together now,
make sure to entertain me lots, okay?

acquisition_text: Sometimes going all out is part of my duty as the head of the Amelhauser family.
description:
A talented alchemist.
She once acted as she pleased as the leader of the Polar Night Alchemists.
Currently on parole, she works as a staff member at a newly opened cafe, though her true motives remain unclear.
With her teasing mannerisms and clever speech, she seems to enjoy toying with others.

leader_skill.description: Boosts P. ATK, M. ATK, P. DEF, and M. DEF by 25% for characters with Fire affinity.
leader_skill.name: I'll Light a Fire in Your Heart

name: Criselda
profile_voice_text: As the head of the Amelhauser family, I can see ahead no matter the situation.

acquisition_text:
This bunny outfit... Do you think
it looks cute on me?
description:
An alchemist cloaked in a dark aura.
She was a member of the Polar Night Alchemists under Criselda's former leadership.
She now works alongside Criselda, who is on parole, as staff at a newly opened café, though her true purpose remains unclear.
Though she has an introverted and contemplative personality, she shows courage when playing card games with her stuffed animals cheering her on.

leader_skill.description: Bookworm characters become faster and gain critical damage +50%.
leader_skill.name: Passion Beyond Books

name: Antje
profile_voice_text:
I have no idea why I ended up wearing this outfit.
But since Criselda is with me, I should try to enjoy it.

acquisition_text:
I'm so happy to celebrate the new year with everyone!
I want to carry this happiness into tomorrow.
description:
An alchemist heading toward World's End.
She's wearing New Year's attire gifted by her mother.
Invited by Kaburaya, she travels to Keiun alongside Alvina to celebrate their New Year festivities.
With her boundless curiosity for knowledge, she's excited to spend the year-end and New Year holidays in Keiun, a land with culture quite different from Lantarna.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Air affinity characters' P.ATK, M.ATK, P.DEF, and M.DEF by 25%.
leader_skill.name: Set Sail with the Wind!

name: Resna
profile_voice_text: Wearing festive attire makes me feel like this will be a wonderful year.

acquisition_text:
My cute outfit is ready and I've got my horn...
...So now, let this year's Starbirth Festival begin!
description:
A beastkin girl who belongs to the Royal Knights.
She's Resna's childhood friend and accompanies her on her journey as a guardian.
Dressed as a Starbirth Festival messenger alongside Resna, she's working hard to liven up the celebration. Though her outfit is different, she hasn't forgotten her duty as a Royal Knight and as a knight protecting Resna.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Seasonal characters' skill damage by 100% when attacking a weakness.
leader_skill.name: Starry Night Melody

name: Izana
profile_voice_text: With this cute outfit and horn, let's celebrate the Starbirth Festival. I'll bring smiles to everyone!

acquisition_text:
Reviving alchemy is my wish as well.
—Now then, let us go together.
description:
Resna's alchemy mentor.
During his travels, he stopped by the village where Resna lived and taught her the basics of alchemy.
He has a cheerful and easygoing personality, but shows a strict side when it comes to alchemy.
His personal life is rather careless, and Resna often ends up taking care of him.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' critical damage by 5% for each Lantarna character in the party.
leader_skill.name: The Wandering Star Is with Us

name: Walther
profile_voice_text: I'm Saskia. Like Resna, I'm a dreaming alchemist. Set your sights on World's End.

acquisition_text:
What I want to do in this town, what I should do.
Let's move forward together, one step at a time!
description:
A friendly and cheerful adventurer.
She hails from the town of Hallfein, which was struck by a mysterious disaster and became a restricted area. She returned to her hometown after a reconstruction plan was launched, hoping to reopen her grandfather's shop, Mistletoe Miscellaneous, and investigate the cause of the disaster.
She has the drive to charge toward her goals and an unyielding spirit, though her bold recklessness often worries her adoptive older sister Camilla.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' P.ATK and M.ATK by 10% for each Promise & Teamwork character in the party.
leader_skill.name: For My Beloved Town Once More

name: Rias
profile_voice_text:
Rias Eidreise of the Mistletoe Miscellaneous!
Turns out I actually have a talent for alchemy!

acquisition_text:
As a descendant of the guardians,
I will continue to protect what has been passed down!
description:
A calm and composed young man.
He hails from the town of Hallfein, which was struck by a mysterious disaster and became a restricted area. He returned to his hometown after a reconstruction plan was launched in order to investigate the meaning of his father's last words.
He handles the management of Mistletoe Miscellaneous but is better suited to physical labor than desk work. He's skilled at all kinds of housework and often takes care of Rias, with whom he lives.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' base P.ATK and base M.ATK by 100 for each Hallfein Restoration Project character in the party.
leader_skill.name: Carrying On My Father's Will

name: Slade
profile_voice_text:
Slade Clauslyter. A descendant of the guardians.
Nice to meet you.

acquisition_text:
Even with this cursed body of mine,
I can go anywhere with my brother!
description: An alchemist whose body is partially transformed into that of a beast. He was once a member of the Polar Night Alchemists, where he would stop at nothing to help his younger brother Tim. Now, together with a recovered Tim, he cooperates with the Lantarna Knights. He finds daily joy in watching his energetic brother grow.

leader_skill.description: All Knight characters gain initiative and boosts their critical damage by 50%.
leader_skill.name: Beyond the Curse

name: Geron
profile_voice_text:
I'm Geron Diezel, an adventurer.
I'm cooperating with the Royal Knights alongside my brother Tim.

acquisition_text:
Just like my brother... I want to become
someone who can help everyone too!
description: Geron's younger brother, a boy whose body is partially transformed into that of a beast. Though he suffered under the curse, he recovered thanks to Geron, Resna, and the others. He now cooperates with the Lantarna Knights alongside Geron. He has a cheerful and kind personality, and after all the kindness he has received, he wishes to live his life helping others.

leader_skill.description: All Diligent characters restore their own HP by 5% when receiving an attack. Also boosts their skill damage and stun damage by 50%.
leader_skill.name: Kindhearted and Energetic Youth

name: Tim
profile_voice_text:
Tim Diezel. I'm Geron's younger brother.
Thanks to everyone, I'm all better now!

acquisition_text: I am darkness itself. My name is Antje Moltke of the Polar Night Alchemists.
description: An alchemist cloaked in a dark aura. A member of the Polar Night Alchemists, she assists her friend Criselda. The four stuffed animals always at her side are her friends, each with their own names, and she occasionally converses with them. She has been tearful since childhood and tends to think about things negatively.

leader_skill.description: Grants Alchemist characters initiative and boosts their skill damage by 50%.
leader_skill.name: Polar Night Witch

name: Antje
profile_voice_text:
I am Antje... One of the Polar Night Alchemists.
I won't let anyone get in our way...

acquisition_text: Everything is...for the sake of fulfilling my desire.
another_name: Leader of the Polar Night Alchemists
description: An alchemist of exceptional talent. As the leader of the Polar Night Alchemists, she conducts alchemy research to fulfill her own desires. With her natural charisma, she recruited talented alchemists from various regions into the Polar Night Alchemists and grew their power. Though her atmosphere is eerie, she has a domestic side, enjoying cooking and sewing.

leader_skill.description: Boosts P.ATK, M.ATK, P.DEF, and M.DEF by 30% for characters with Dark Memories.
leader_skill.name: Polar Night's Charisma

name: Criselda
profile_voice_text:
I am Criselda, leader of the Polar Night Alchemists.
Remember that name well.

acquisition_text:
I might be able to make a new pie!
Please take me along too!
description:
A cheerful and energetic alchemist.
She has an extraordinary passion for making pies and works tirelessly every day to captivate people with her baking.
While she can be a bit clumsy and airheaded at times, she is always positive and hardworking.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Rising Star characters' critical damage by 40%.
leader_skill.name: <Rising Star> Critical Damage Up

name: Rorona
profile_voice_text:
Ehehe. I'm so happy I can bake pies every day.
I'm so glad I got to work at the cafe!

acquisition_text:
Your dream—
please let me help you achieve it!
description:
An alchemist shouldering her clan's mission.
She overlapped the mana depletion occurring on this continent with the drought affecting her homeland, and has been traveling in search of clues to save her home.
She has a strong sense of responsibility and is energetic and hardworking. She can also be a bit stubborn at times.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Rising Star characters' stun damage by 25%. Also boosts their skill damage by 25% when the attack target is stunned.
leader_skill.name: <Rising Star> Stun Damage Up

name: Shallistera
profile_voice_text:
To fulfill my mission of saving my homeland,
I must do everything in my power.

acquisition_text:
I'm getting excited!
Off to new adventures!
description:
An adventure-loving alchemist.
After saving Resna from monsters, she began accompanying her on various adventures.
She has a free-spirited personality and acts before she worries. She has a strong sense of justice and won't easily back down from what she believes is right.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Rising Star characters' P. DEF and M. DEF by 15%.
leader_skill.name: <Rising Star> P. DEF & M. DEF Up

name: Ryza
profile_voice_text:
Working at the cafe is so much fun!
I get to hear all sorts of interesting stories!

acquisition_text: Heading for the World's End—let's go!
description: A fledgling alchemist. She has an extraordinary love and extensive knowledge of alchemy, revealing her inner "alchemy otaku." She gets so excited about alchemy that she tends to speak rapidly. Her dream is to revive the now-defunct practice of alchemy and enrich people's lives.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Rising Star characters' skill damage by 40%.
leader_skill.name: <Rising Star> Skill Damage Up

name: Resna
profile_voice_text: I'm Resna. I'll do my very best to catch up to my seniors!

acquisition_text: Leave the fighting to me. I'm confident in my abilities.
description: An amnesiac warrior. Her combat skills are top-notch, and alongside her partner Heidi, she's handled various odd jobs. Having lost her memories of the past, she lives while searching for answers about her identity. She has a strong-willed personality and speaks bluntly, but when pushed, she can be surprisingly weak-willed. In her private life, her sloppy side tends to show, often causing those around her to fuss over her.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Rising Star characters' P.ATK by 25%.
leader_skill.name: <Rising Star> P.ATK Up

name: Valeria
profile_voice_text: I'm Valeria. I don't have any memories of the past, but...well, I'm having fun.

acquisition_text: Inspector trainee, moving out! I'll do my best to maintain order today too!
description: An Archipelago Federation inspector trainee. Together with her superior Els, she works to maintain order in the Archipelago Federation. She has a kind personality and tends to trust people too much, but her combat instincts are sharp, and Els has high expectations for her future. Because she sleeps and eats well, she appears particularly worn out when work gets busy.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' P.ATK and M.ATK by 12% for each Infinite Island Chain character in the party.
leader_skill.name: Archipelago Federation Inspector Trainee

name: Tiny
profile_voice_text: My track record as an inspector is still pretty shallow, but I'm improving daily under my boss!

acquisition_text: Why don't we watch how this journey unfolds? Through these two eyes behind the mask.
description: A bounty hunter active in the Archipelago Federation. Their true identity is unknown as they hide their face behind a mask and use a false name. Inspector Els recognizes their combat skills and has invited them to become an inspector, but they have declined. They act carefree and often tease Tiny, which frequently earns them the ire of the stern Els.

leader_skill.description: Grants Infinite Island Chain characters initiative and boosts their critical damage by 50%.
leader_skill.name: Mysterious Bounty Hunter

name: José
profile_voice_text: I hate to brag, but I'm a pretty skilled bounty hunter.

acquisition_text:
Alchemy is a great power to fulfill one's desires.
Is that not so?
another_name: Queen of the Kingdom of Lara
description: A noble-appearing alchemist aspiring to establish her own kingdom. She belongs to the Polar Night Alchemists in pursuit of her dream of founding the Kingdom of Lara. When she finds someone she likes or sees potential in, she tries to recruit them to the Kingdom of Lara. She proudly proclaims her real name as a form of revenge against the family that mistreated her.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Lantarna characters' skill damage by 100% when attack target is paralyzed.
leader_skill.name: Polar Night's Daughter

name: Lara
profile_voice_text: I am Lara Trockel. Queen of the promised land, the Kingdom of Lara.

acquisition_text: I will do what I must do.
description:
A homunculus created by the Palme, and the sixth of the Miraculous Nine.
Together with the other members of the Nine, she carries out "management" under the Palme's orders.
She is responsible for devising strategies and providing support, excelling at eliminating small fry.
Believing that good thinking requires good sleep, she is particular about her sleeping environment.

leader_skill.description: Reduces damage received by Dark Memories characters by 25%.
leader_skill.name: Razor-Sharp Mind

name: Liebe
profile_voice_text: My name is Liebe. I am in charge of tactics and operational command.

acquisition_text: Don't worry—we will protect the peace and order of this archipelago.
description:
A female inspector for the Archipelago Federation.
She works together with her apprentice Tiny to maintain order in the Archipelago Federation.
Her strict professionalism has earned her the title "Steel Els," and criminals are said to tremble at the mention of her name.
She has a desire to repair things that are in poor condition, and when not working, she performs maintenance around the inspector headquarters.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Infinite Island Chain characters' P. ATK, M. ATK, P. DEF, and M. DEF by 30%.
leader_skill.name: Steel Inspector

name: Els
profile_voice_text:
Els Martin. I'm an inspector.
If you have nothing to hide, there's nothing to fear, right?

acquisition_text:
Reviving alchemy is my wish as well.
Now, let us go together.
description:
Resna's alchemy mentor.
She stopped by Resna's village during her travels and taught her the basics of alchemy.
She has a bright and carefree personality, but shows a strict side when it comes to alchemy.
Her personal life is quite messy, and Resna often helps look after her.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' critical damage by 5% for each Lantarna character in the party.
leader_skill.name: The Comet Travels with Us

name: Izana
profile_voice_text:
I'm Saskia. An alchemist with dreams, just like Resna.
Aim for World's End, you hear?

acquisition_text:
Reviving alchemy is my wish as well.
Now, let us go together.
description:
Resna's alchemy mentor.
She stopped by Resna's village during her travels and taught her the basics of alchemy.
She has a bright and carefree personality, but shows a strict side when it comes to alchemy.
Her personal life is quite messy, and Resna often helps look after her.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' critical damage by 5% for each Lantarna character in the party.
leader_skill.name: The Comet Travels with Us

name: Johanna
profile_voice_text:
I'm Saskia. An alchemist with dreams, just like Resna.
Aim for World's End, you hear?

acquisition_text:
A ninja-style idol means a stealthy one!
I'll captivate you with energy and flair!
description:
Leader of the animal-themed idol unit "Cutie☆AnimaL." Her motif animal is a fox.
She was approached by the president of "Lara Production" when her idol activities at her previous agency weren't going well.
She loves trying new things and eagerly jumps on board when there's an interesting project.
She thinks of Izana and Johanna like troublesome younger sisters.

leader_skill.description: Boosts M.ATK by 50% for characters with Bolt affinity.
leader_skill.name: Leader of the Unit

name: Kimon
profile_voice_text:
I'm Kimon. I disliked the old-fashioned ways of shinobi,
so I entered the fun yet strict path of being an idol.

acquisition_text:
Sorry to keep you waiting, partner!
You can count on Heidi now that she's shed her skin!
description:
Valeria's partner, who is actually the daughter of a noble family.
She ran away from home after growing tired of her quarrelsome parents, but a letter from her old local friend Caroline prompted her to properly face her family again.
This outfit reflects her mother's taste rather than Heidi's preference, but she's quite fond of the footwear as it's surprisingly easy to move around in.

leader_skill.description: Boosts base P.ATK & base M.ATK by 300 for Family & Friends characters.
leader_skill.name: The Partner Returns

name: Heidi
profile_voice_text:
Hehe, the atmosphere's changed quite a bit, don't you think?
You can look forward to the new and improved Heidi!

acquisition_text:
For those who won't listen to reason—
I'll let this gun do the talking.
description:
A sister who works at a church in Ruine Province, as well as an adventurer.
Her parents were killed by monsters, and she was taken in by the church.
Due to her unique philosophy that "battle is dialogue," she attacks even monsters with proper etiquette. Those around her say her demeanor is both gentle and terrifying.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' skill damage & stun damage by 20% for each Lantarna character in the party.
leader_skill.name: Traveling Sister

name: Caroline
profile_voice_text:
I am Caroline, a sister of the church.
This gun is for protecting those dear to me.

acquisition_text: We were created to protect the Palme from all kinds of disasters.
description:
A homunculus created by the Palme and the fourth of the Miraculous Nine.
Along with the other Miraculous Nine, they carry out "management" under orders from the Palme.
Behind their carefree demeanor lies a surprisingly competitive and stubborn nature.
They love beautiful things and find happiness in gazing at gemstones.

leader_skill.description: Dark Memories characters gain skill damage +50% and take 25% less damage from enemies inflicted with Provoke.
leader_skill.name: Whimsical Little Devil

name: Citrine
profile_voice_text: Hey there, I'm Citrine! I'm the self-proclaimed handyperson of the sacred lands of Nova... or so I've been told.
